construction.physical_operation: Cut a finite set of complete owners around one source-owner boundary mark. Owner frames remain identity.
construction.native_decoder: Multiply the exact rational normalized centers by(3sqrt2/4)*(100000001/100000000), round to binary64 and retain identity quaternions. Use exact nominal scale*(1+1e-8)+1e-8 rounded outward. The full native checker treats all numeric inputs as exact rationals.
